name: Meeting & Incident Summarization
description: Summarise short operational transcripts into the decisions and owners that matter. Correctness is judged against a reference summary, faithfulness against the transcript.

default_config.system_prompt: Summarise the transcript in two or three sentences. Include every decision and named owner. Do not add recommendations of your own.

metric_notes.correctness: Compared against a reference summary; a judge model is recommended because wording varies legitimately.
metric_notes.faithfulness: Summaries invent action items surprisingly often — this is the metric that catches it.
metric_notes.response_length: Informational only; useful for spotting models that ignore the length instruction.
